answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 65885 Country: India Title: Can a person give zakah to his teacher (Ustad)? Question: Can a person give zakah to his teacher (Ustad)? An earlier reply would be much appreciated. Answer ID: 65885 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 967/994/L=09/1437) If the teacher is poor and eligible for receiving zakah then a student may give zakah to his teacher. However, it is better that instead of giving zakah amount to a teacher he supports him by other ways. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
